title: Lesson 1 - The Magic Classroom
focus: Listen / Look / Say as first command chunks
can_do: I can hear three classroom commands and choose the right action.
output: Point to the correct action card.
repair_focus: Replay three-command board and retry matching.

title: Lesson 2 - Listen, Look, Point
can_do: I can follow listen, look, and point commands.

title: Lesson 3 - Say It Again
focus: Say / Say it again / One more time
can_do: I can repeat a classroom word or phrase.
output: Repeat one command or greeting after a model.

title: Lesson 4 - Stand Up, Sit Down
focus: Stand up / Sit down action contrast
can_do: I can understand and perform stand up and sit down.
output: Do stand up and sit down in order.

title: Lesson 5 - Open And Close
focus: Open your book / Close your book
can_do: I can follow open and close commands with a book.
output: Open and close a book or card.

title: Lesson 6 - Read And Write
can_do: I can understand read and write in classroom work.
repair_focus: Read/write icon board and copy support.

title: Lesson 7 - Classroom Magic Mission
focus: Choose, order, say, and act four commands
can_do: I can choose and say four classroom commands.
repair_focus: Choose four safe commands and record again.

title: Watch - The Magic Action Class
focus: Watch command routine and identify actions
can_do: I can watch and choose classroom commands.

title: Final Project - My Classroom Action Recording
can_do: I can record four classroom commands with actions.
